title: Business-Wrap diagram model
description: The model of a document block {kind:'diagram', caption, model}. engine/diagram.mjs draws it (house workflow look) as SVG shapes with real text for the editor and the PDF, and as native Word shapes for the DOCX. A node without x/y is placed by the auto layout; edges are routed from the node geometry (orthogonal, rounded corners) unless they carry hand-set bend points (via). Edits change it with the edits contract: {op:'replace', path:'<block>/model', value:<model>} or setText on <block>/model/nodes/<i>/label.

blockFrame.description: 0.15.9 · The canvas of a diagram block. It is a key of the BLOCK ({kind:'diagram', caption, model, frame}), beside the model, not inside it; absent = the drawing exactly as before (byte for byte). The canvas is wMm x hMm millimetres; the drawing keeps its proportions, is centred and is scaled to fit (never stretched, never cut, at most 0.4 mm per drawing unit). It is kept inside the room the page leaves (engine/render.mjs figureRoom): never over a title, the note, the header, the footer, another page or the margin. Both editions of a pair carry the same frame. Written with {op:'replace', path:'<block>/frame', value} and removed with {op:'delete', path:'<block>/frame'}. The editor view, the PDF, the DOCX and the HTML show the same size.

mode.description: How it was set: 0 = dragged by hand, 1 = fit to shapes, 2 = fit to page. A number, never a word: a string under a block would be read as editable text.

side.description: The face: top, right, bottom or left.

at.description: How far along the face: top to bottom for l and r, left to right for t and b. Kept as a fraction, so it survives moving and resizing the shape.

frame.description: Documentation only: the canvas lives on the block, not on the model (see $defs.blockFrame). A model never carries it.

flow.description: Direction of the chain (the house reference runs left to right in both editions).

legend.description: false hides the legend; an object renames entries by key (staff, applicant, rework, payment, system, stop, ok, note, wire-main, wire-return, wire-stop).

legendHide.description: Legend entries deleted by hand, by key (staff, applicant, rework, payment, system, stop, ok, note, wire-main, wire-return, wire-stop). They stay deleted when shapes change; absent = every automatic entry shows.

legendLook.description: The swatch of a legend entry, by entry key: skin:<shape colour>, wire:<main|return|stop> or sym:<symbol>. Absent = the entry's own.

color.description: Theme colour role; absent = the kind's own.

icons.description: Badges; absent = the kind's own, [] = none.

auto.description: A group band the auto layout made (rebuilt on re-layout).

kind.description: main = solid forward path, return = dashed brown, stop = thin red refusal. Absent = derived (to a refusal end = stop; backwards or via rework = return).

label.description: May hold a line feed (Shift+Enter in the editor) for a hand-made line break.

via.description: Bend points [x, y] set by hand between the two ends; the router keeps every segment orthogonal (an elbow is added where an end moved). Absent = automatic routing.

route.description: How the line runs between its joints. Absent = elbow (orthogonal, rounded corners). straight = straight legs through the joints; curved = a smooth curve through the joints.

head.description: The end at `to`. Absent = arrow (the open chevron).

line.description: The stroke pattern. Absent = the kind's own (return is dashed).

weight.description: The stroke width. Absent = the kind's own.

fromAnchor.description: Where the arrow leaves the `from` shape: a point on its outline. Absent = automatic.

toAnchor.description: Where the arrow enters the `to` shape. Absent = automatic.
